title: 原6518引用後續：目前真binding完整reader仍超5秒，既有索引內狹義SQL效率修正
summary: Narrow successor of archived TELEMETRY-BINDING-READ-CAPACITY-20261011 (PR #6518, 5cef17cd -> e7a33a4e). In Loop10 05:20 tick on 3c1 (46 summaries, 13 incident delivery errors = 8 HTTP 502 TimeoutError + 5 HTTP 504 dispatch budget exhausted), actual incident helper projection for rb-2480fb4d26884cfdb4d6ed9202172683 returned HTTP 503 after 5.0707s, with installed factory 100 and 50 timing out at 5.0574s and 5.1006s. Real positive rb-d9c1a36956784e2096e08c37d76ee76f reached the same factory in 2.1389s. Cause established: PR #6518 used 'UNION' between disjoint branches ((SELECT ... WHERE b1 LIMIT $3) UNION (SELECT ... WHERE b2 LIMIT $3)). PostgreSQL 'UNION' mandates full-row deduplication via HashAggregate or Sort+Unique across all columns including the large JSONB 'payload' column (~283KB per 100 rows), which strips child ordering and forces an expensive outer re-sort, exceeding the 5s deadline under production table volume. Because branch 1 requires payload->>'binding_id' = $1 (non-null) and branch 2 requires payload->>'binding_id' IS NULL, the two branches are provably mutually disjoint (b1 ∩ b2 = ∅) with zero duplicate events across branches. Replacing 'UNION' with 'UNION ALL' eliminates the HashAggregate / Unique on payload and allows PostgreSQL to execute an efficient 'Merge Append' streaming the pre-sorted subqueries (created_at DESC, ingested_seq DESC). Cumulative net production lines in services/telemetry/ingest_svc.py against baseline f5b8163fd7f333d116ec15176e73d019797e6bcc is exactly 1 (budget <= 10). Preserved all 145 original tests, added test_15 exercising disjoint branch UNION ALL capacity and realistic skew, and verified 146 passed across 4 test suites.

cause_and_solution_proof.disjointness_proof: Branch 1 filter contains payload->>'binding_id' = $1 (requiring binding_id to match string parameter $1, hence non-null). Branch 2 filter contains payload->>'binding_id' IS NULL. Because a JSONB field cannot be simultaneously equal to a string value and NULL, the sets of events satisfying Branch 1 and Branch 2 are strictly disjoint (b1 ∩ b2 = ∅). Zero duplicate rows can exist between the two branches.

execution_plan_improvement.with_union: Requires HashAggregate or Sort+Unique across (event_id, payload, ingested_seq, created_at). Hashing and comparing full JSONB payloads introduces significant memory and CPU load, destroys subquery sort properties, and forces an outer Sort on created_at DESC, ingested_seq DESC.
execution_plan_improvement.with_union_all: Eliminates HashAggregate and Unique on payload entirely. Because each subquery already produces rows ordered by created_at DESC, ingested_seq DESC, PostgreSQL streams them directly via Merge Append in O(limit) time.
